info.long_name: Proportion of students up to date for measles-mumps-rubella (MMR) vaccination
info.short_description: Proportion of assessed school students who are up to date for measles-mumps-rubella (MMR) vaccination.
info.long_description: Share of assessed school students reported as up to date for measles-mumps-rubella (MMR) vaccination in the state's annual school immunization survey. The antigen-specific series definition, the grade(s) assessed, and whether the figure reflects all enrolled students or only those surveyed vary by state; see the source description.
info.statement: In {location}, {value} of school students were up to date for MMR vaccination.

info.long_name: Proportion of students with a non-medical (personal-belief) vaccination exemption
info.short_description: Proportion of assessed school students with a non-medical exemption (religious, philosophical, or personal-belief) from vaccination requirements.
info.long_description: Share of assessed school students holding a non-medical exemption from one or more required vaccines. The exemption categories permitted differ by state law - some allow religious exemptions only, others also allow philosophical or personal-belief exemptions - and this harmonized field aggregates whichever non-medical categories the state reports.
info.statement: In {location}, {value} of school students had a non-medical vaccination exemption.

info.long_name: Proportion of students with a medical vaccination exemption
info.short_description: Proportion of assessed school students with a medical exemption from one or more required vaccines.
info.long_description: Share of assessed school students with a physician-certified medical exemption from one or more required vaccines, as reported in the state's annual school immunization survey.
info.statement: In {location}, {value} of school students had a medical vaccination exemption.

info.long_name: Proportion of students with a medical exemption from MMR vaccination
info.short_description: Proportion of assessed school students with a medical exemption from the MMR vaccination requirement.
info.long_description: Share of assessed school students holding a medical exemption from the MMR vaccine specifically. Reported by states that break exemptions out by antigen.
info.statement: In {location}, {value} of school students had a medical exemption from MMR vaccination.

info.long_name: Proportion of students with a religious exemption from MMR vaccination
info.short_description: Proportion of assessed school students with a religious exemption from the MMR vaccination requirement.
info.long_description: Share of assessed school students holding a religious exemption from the MMR series specifically. An exemption rate, not a coverage rate.
info.statement: In {location}, {value} of school students had a religious exemption from MMR vaccination.
